images.name: 12_same_view_new_height_ingame
images.final_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one 16:9 landscape concept image, clean Roblox in-game graphics.
References: image 1 owner_frame_ingame.png is the authoritative place, parts, colours and viewing direction; image 2 ref_height.png is scale guidance only (never copy its diagram or text); image 3 sheet_ingame.jpg is Roblox material and colour guidance only, not a collage.
Rebuild the SAME scene from image 1 upward, retaining its frontal slightly oblique viewing direction, with camera pulled back and tilted up enough to show ALL SIX stacked storeys and the roof high above. Keep the grey concrete column left of centre with blue padding at its foot, the long dark-blue horizontal tube across the lower front, yellow and green padded posts, black safety netting, blue deck edges, red square panels with round white/clear bubble windows in yellow rings. Repeat those red bubble-window panels on EVERY one of SIX clearly countable deck-over-deck storeys. The frame continues far beyond both left and right image edges, city-block scale. Add solid blue, red and yellow horizontal tubes at different heights. Three very long glossy enclosed tube slides, each entirely ONE solid colour: green on right foreground, red farther right, yellow nearby, descending continuously from fifth/sixth storeys to floor. No striped or multicolour tubes.
Warehouse roof is about 34m high, roughly three times screenshot height, with substantial empty air above the six-storey 17m frame. Dark steel roof, joists and ducts, small distant white fluorescent strips. Blue and green checker foam floor, a few scattered loose balls. Same flat bright colours, smooth simple Roblox parts and glossy plastic as owner screenshot; NOT photorealistic, no dust filter.
Readable exact signs only: yellow sign "THE BIG FRAME", small red signs "PLAY ZONE" with arrows, white sign "NO ADULTS". No other lettering, diagram labels, UI, HUD or watermark. No people, animals, entity, arcade cabinets, claw machines, prize shelves, neon or full ball pit. Do not add new zones into this specific camera view. Frame fills width, all six storeys visible vertically, roof far above.
CRITICAL SCALE CORRECTION: Camera much farther back, wide landscape, enough space above frame that its top is at image vertical midpoint and floor at bottom 85%; roof at top 5%, huge clear dark air gap. Six full floors remain clearly countable. ALL three slides must be ENCLOSED TUBES with round mouths, not open chutes. Green slide also begins on SIXTH floor, not second floor. Red and yellow begin fifth and sixth floors. Show all three tube runs and floor mouths inside image. Keep frontal view and column at left third. This is a vast tall warehouse, not low ceiling.
images.weakness: Six storeys and correct readable signs; roof clearance remains understated, yellow slide exit is cropped, and wider off-frame continuation is weak.

images.name: 13_same_view_new_height_concept
images.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One 16:9 landscape PHOTOREAL dim abandoned soft-play warehouse concept artwork.
Input references: image 1 owner_frame_ingame.png is authoritative for the same place, viewing direction, actual parts and colours. Image 2 style_frame.png supplies ONLY photoreal dusty abandoned materials, light and atmosphere; do NOT copy its low height or striped slides. Image 3 ref_height.png supplies new scale only, never its diagram or lettering.
Show the SAME frontal slightly oblique composition as the owner screenshot, camera pulled much farther back and slightly tilted up to reveal SIX full stacked storeys of the play frame, and vast empty air above up to a cathedral-high warehouse roof 34 metres overhead. Frame is roughly 17m tall, six decks ~2.8m apart, city-block width continuing out of view left and right. Grey concrete column at left third with blue padded foot. Long dark blue horizontal tube crosses lower facade behind the column. Yellow and green padded posts, black knotted safety-net fences, blue deck edges, red square panels with round clear/whitish bubble windows and yellow rings on EVERY storey. Six distinct stacked deck levels must be visible and countable. Other solid red and yellow horizontal tubes cross upper levels.
Three long glossy ENCLOSED TUBE slides descend from fifth/sixth floors to floor on right: solid green nearest centre-right, solid red farther right, solid yellow farthest right. Every slide one continuous solid colour including joints, never striped; all three mouths and continuous long routes visible. Keep camera composition consistent with a wide pulled-back game screenshot of this facade.
Abandoned 1990s indoor soft-play centre, nobody there, dim dusty quiet Backrooms mood. Worn coloured vinyl padding and mat decks, dusty plastic, slightly brighter/saturated than real derelict so colours read. Worn blue-and-green checker foam puzzle floor, a few missing tiles exposing grey concrete, a few loose plastic balls. Sparse cold WHITE fluorescent strips small and far overhead, some dead, shadow pools and haze; dark exposed steel-deck roof with joists and ducts, vast dark air gap above frame. Do not crowd ceiling down onto frame.
Exact readable signage only: yellow sign "THE BIG FRAME" near lower central facade, small red signs "PLAY ZONE" with arrows. No "NO ADULTS" sign in this image; no other text. No people, children, animals, entity, arcade machines, claw machines, prize shelves, neon, full ball pit, watermark, HUD, UI, collage or diagram. All six storeys, floor and high roof visible.
CRITICAL FRAMING: pull back substantially more. Frame top must fall around 40 percent down from image top, floor meets structure around 85 percent down. Fill upper third with VAST EMPTY DARK AIR between frame and distant ceiling, ceiling around 34m vs 17m play frame. Maintain six unmistakable full storeys and large facade continuing outside left/right boundaries. Column at left third. Three closed tubular slides with round mouths, no open chute. All three start at fifth/sixth storeys and end on floor, mouths fully within right half. Near-frontal facade with mild perspective, not an exaggerated steep low-angle view. Match clean game's pulled-back composition while making materials photoreal.
images.weakness: Six storeys, solid-colour tubes and readable signs; roof still feels lower than 34m, framing is only approximately matched to image 12, and floor has a somewhat wet sheen.
